topic_coverage.quoted_user_text: Agents should have a reliable codebase map available without requiring the user to remember a separate manual map-codebase step in fresh repos.
.cursor/commands/map-codebase.md, phase command policies (intake/discovery/execute), docs/engineering/codebase-map.md ownership, and active/template parity surfaces.

Keep map generation deterministic and bounded to avoid noisy rewrites; preserve manual map-codebase command while adding optional/automatic bootstrap behavior; avoid violating artifact ownership contracts.
Add regression tests proving codebase-map.md exists for fresh lifecycle runs and remains valid/idempotent on reruns; verify active/template parity and no unexpected ownership violations.
Done when there is a deterministic workflow path where TL or Dev creates/refreshes codebase-map for fresh repos, documented and regression-guarded, without requiring user guesswork.
